meta.title: Saving an email template with duplicate name returns validation error

steps.note: Open the prepared draft eRFX project on its create screen.
Navigate to the Technical Stage where the contract template component is configured.

args.goal: On the Technical Stage, open Edit for the 'Special condition of the contract' template component, replace its text with the provided updated special condition text, click Save, verify the updated text is shown, exercise the Required and Not Required toggles and confirm their states change, and delete a line item if the component exposes line-item deletion; stop on the Technical Stage showing the saved template fields and resulting line-item state.

steps.note: Perform and verify the component-specific buyer actions that have no dedicated catalog step.
Confirm the Technical Stage remains rendered without errors after saving the template changes.
